title: Audit selected k8 helper endpoint rigidity and rank-preserving failures
body:
The selected k8 word's owner auditor consumes residual widths, so a same-rank but incompatible endpoint cap is invisible at that boundary. Add a source-pinned audit package that records the forcing frame/gate for every helper and executes 78 such local frame adversaries. The existing local admission rejects every fixture after both exact scalar endpoint maps pass; this is corroboration of that defense, not a selected acceptance bug.

For the unchanged gates, entrances, gate frames and early/full cleanup schedule, all 480 helper endpoints are minimal: 78 restricted ends equal their last native frame and 402 helpers occur in full-frame cleanup. Equal-rank endpoint replacements must therefore be the original subspaces. The span argument excludes 105,927,652 alternative single-end same-rank caps containing their original entrances; 78 representative mutants are actually executed, not 105 million enumerated cases. All 480 owner-width inputs stay identical. One complete retained owner replay covers 69,120 roles and 144 calls.

Started from current main `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f` and followed the `supplier-boundary-audit` card (nonce `1f08d36879e997ec973cb952b5221865`). Scope, sources, exact predecessor heads, receipt and next question are in `research/k8-helper-endpoint-audit/`. [Coordination and claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1378). Initial final overlap checked 854 open PRs including drafts and 100 discussions with complete pagination. After the session resumed, refreshed again at 2026-10-14 03:26 UTC: 725 open PRs and 229 discussions, complete pagination and no coverage warnings. Newly returned PR1525 concerns a bit P111 decoder chronology and does not cover the selected complex k8 helper endpoint census; historical PR892 remains explicitly credited. These title/body/note searches do not establish novelty across every code diff.

Validation:
- Python 3.12.14 registered replay: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/k8-helper-endpoint-audit`.
- Python 3.14.7 isolated optimized replay and six tests from a read-only minimal relocated source tree with spaces in its path.
- Source-payload equality before mutations, frozen word-pin rejection for every mutant, six small-domain/source-tampering tests, selected-record integrity and staged whitespace checks.

No selected source, frontier, native compiler or historical package is changed. No full selected cold replay, changed-tail synthesis, global moment optimum, physical adoption, hosted-CI success, all-size theorem or new kappa is claimed. Enlarged endpoints are not priced. Credit Rohan Arun PR1094, Jeremy Kothe and retained gauge44 lineage, Josie Elliston PR1091, Sagar Thakrar PR1049, and Douglas Colkitt's composition. PR892 already proves a different historical helper's endpoint floor; PR1358/1312/1238 cover distinct neighboring boundaries. New material Apache-2.0, prepared for Arham Tahir with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human peer-review claim.
